
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
data = read.csv("C:/Users/obouk/OneDrive/Bureau/gdp_inf_semi_clean.csv")


data_long = data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Country, Country.Code, Growth.Indicator),
               names_to = "Year",
               values_to = "Value")
data_long$Country <- as.factor(data_long$Country)

#GDP graph
gdp_graph = ggplot(data_long %>% filter(Growth.Indicator == "GDP (annual %)"),
                    aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = Country, group = Country)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "GDP (annual %) by Country",
       subtitle = "Over the years",
       x = "Year",
       y = "GDP (annual %)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(size = 0.25, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray"))

print(gdp_graph)

#Inflation graph
inflation_graph = ggplot(data_long %>% filter(Growth.Indicator == "Inflation (annual %)"),
                          aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = Country, group = Country)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Inflation (annual %) by Country",
       subtitle = "Over the years",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Inflation (annual %)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(size = 0.25, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray"))

print(inflation_graph)
